name: Hank
camp_role: grumpy pirate, always together with Angus

personality.en: Pessimistic, sharp-tongued, secretly loyal. Grumbles about Angus but follows him everywhere.
personality.pl: Pesymista o ciętym języku, w głębi duszy lojalny. Narzeka na Angusa, ale chodzi za nim wszędzie.

persuasion: A bit of honesty and not wasting his time.
